digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / completion verifier close path
propositions: A CODE-VERIFIABLE acceptance criterion retagged [operator-attested] (evidence: repository path/symbol) passes plan-review and completion verification despite layered guards designed to reject such laundering.
The plan-review evidence-kind criterion either does not fire or is advisory on tagged repository-provable ACs, leaving LLM judgment as the only blocking layer.
The det_measurement_provenance detector identifies missing provenance: continuation lines but is wired as ADVISORY (p6_ac_quality), so it surfaces coaching instead of blocking.
The completion verifier trusts the [operator-attested] tag at face value per ADR-0043 and ADR design, exempting it from repository evidence checks.
A deterministic, fail-closed guard must run on the close path before the verifier, detecting [operator-attested] ACs citing exact repo paths/symbols and blocking unless split or untagged.
Missing provenance: lines on [operator-attested] external ACs must be rejected at close time (det_measurement_provenance promoted to blocking for close-path reviews only).
